meta.name: scholarly-citation
meta.description: Verifiable-attribution and citation-discipline craft — atomic claim decomposition, evidence grading (primary/analysis/forecast tiers), claimant attribution, citation typing (cites/references/contradicts/defines), source anchoring (Xanadu). Use when writing or reviewing a reference or synthesis page that attributes and cites source-based claims so they stay traceable, or when claim attribution, citation typing, or evidence grading is needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为写作内容添加可追溯的引用和证据分级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或报告中的每个观点标注来源和证据等级
copy.tagline_en: Add traceable citations and evidence grading to your writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to attribute every claim with source and evidence level in your articles or reports

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照学术引用规范处理每个主张：将主张拆分为原子句，标注证据等级（事实/分析/预测），指明主张者，分类引用含义（引用/参考/反驳/定义），并锚定到来源的具体章节。
howto.when: 当你在编写或审阅需要引用来源的页面，或需要处理主张归属、引用分类、证据分级时触发。

say.text: 请把这段文字拆成原子主张，并标注证据等级。
检查这个引用是 cites 还是 references。
say.note: Claude 会判断引用含义类型。

say.text: 给这个直接引语加上来源章节锚点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude processes each claim following scholarly citation standards: decomposes claims into atomic sentences, grades evidence (fact/analysis/forecast), attributes claimants, classifies citation meaning (cites/references/contradicts/defines), and anchors to source sections.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing or reviewing a reference or synthesis page that requires source attribution, or when claim attribution, citation typing, or evidence grading is needed.

say_en.text: Decompose this text into atomic claims and grade the evidence.
say_en.note: Claude will mark each line with [fact], [analysis], or [forecast].

say_en.text: Check whether this citation is cites or references.
say_en.note: Claude will classify the citation meaning type.

say_en.text: Add a source section anchor to this direct quote.
say_en.note: Claude will add an anchor in [[slug#section]] format.
